fields.title: SR-200 ductility and available blank dimensions are misstated or incompletely transferred
fields.evidence: The owner's post_yield field says about 2–3% elongation. The cited SR-200 sheet datasheet specifies 10% minimum over a one-inch gauge. It allows 0.020–0.058-inch sheet only at reduced width/length; the 0.7946mm face falls in that range. The assumed 0.6096x1.8288m blank and 18-panels-per-face count are not established for it.
fields.proposed_fix: Use the sheet-specific tensile requirement without treating it as formed/biaxial fracture data. Re-layout seams and price actual gauges/blanks. Carry CHECK038 and CHECK042 qualifications.

claim: SR-200 ductility and available blank dimensions are misstated or incompletely transferred
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
